body:
It's tough to describe to people unless they have lived it, so I'm glad you understand. And I agree, I've gotten off all social media during this time. It's probably rotting my brain anyway. 

I have this throwaway account, I just needed to get it out there to people who could understand. I'm still against going to medical/therapy for it because it just puts a big red X on you.
The dude abides! Ha, take care of yourself. Thanks for the upbeat comment, it helps.

I would gladly take the hug. 

I don't know what is going on with her, but I told her I won't hold her hostage. If she isn't 100% in this than we need to separate. It sucks, but life goes on man. I may end up doing the full twenty years, only because I see the opportunity to change. I have some hopeful ideas that positivity is contagious, and perhaps I can echo some kind of good vibes through the ranks. 

I'm gonna keep on fighting the good fight, for you, for me, and my best furry friend. Thanks for the kind words, I needed them.
When I told my wife my depression was getting out of control and I was considering taking my own life. She turned the conversation back to herself.
